§ 01 · The Program

Real pressure,
real decisions.

From handling sudden market changes and difficult conversations, to negotiating with resistant stakeholders, managing a crisis, and communicating with executives, every scenario drops you into a genuine business challenge and asks one question: what should you actually do? Sixty-eight foundations-focused scenarios and thirty-two strategy-and-crisis-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real business judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual challenge a working professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across crisis response, strategic adaptability, negotiation, difficult conversations, and executive communication.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound business judgment under real pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Communication Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping working professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency at work isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who want to handle real workplace pressure confidently in English — Mr. Gad General Business Challenges is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the difficult moments you'll actually face.
